label: Calm Ops
description: Light operations dashboard with air and a few honest numbers. For daytime ops and support leads — not a frosted glass analytics toy and not a dense terminal.
signatureMotif: light airy ops board, few KPIs, and a readable work queue
promptHints: Open on a light overview: 3–4 KPIs with room around them, then a work queue. Do not pack 12 sparkline tiles.
Tables are readable (15–16px, row height 48px+). Status is a quiet pill, not a neon badge.
This is a day-shift board. No glassmorphism and no terminal green-on-black.

layouts: Top row: page title + date range + one primary action. Next: 3–4 KPI tiles in a single row with a number, a 7-day spark, and a one-word delta — then stop.
Main body is a work queue or ticket table taking ~60% width, with a slim right rail for filters or a selected-item summary — not a widget wall.
Charts, if needed, are one large line or bar under the queue, not a mosaic of 6 mini-charts.
Empty and zero states stay on-canvas with a sentence, not a dark empty glass panel.
motifs: White/gray-100 ground, slate text, one calm blue or green for positive delta. Hairline cards, 0.6rem radius.
IBM Plex Sans for numbers and titles; Inter for table copy. Tabular figures on every metric.
Alerts use amber text, not red full-row fills. Density stays low enough to scan in 3 seconds.
antiPatterns: Do not use glass-frosted: dark canvas, blur panels, glow metrics, or layered glass cards.
Avoid dense-terminal: mono walls, 12px tables, and CRT-green accents.
No 8–12 widget bento on the first screen. If you need that many numbers, you picked the wrong variant.
